proof_body:
by
  intro G _ N _ h1 h2
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := h1.out
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := h2.out
  refine ⟨⟨S.image N.subtype ∪ T.image Quotient.out, ?_⟩⟩
  set L := Subgroup.closure ((S.image N.subtype ∪ T.image Quotient.out : Finset G) : Set G) with hL
  have hNL : N ≤ L := by
    intro x hx
    have hm : (⟨x, hx⟩ : N) ∈ Subgroup.closure (S : Set N) := by rw [hS]; trivial
    have key : ∀ y ∈ Subgroup.closure (S : Set N), (y : G) ∈ L := by
      intro y hy
      refine Subgroup.closure_induction (p := fun (y : N) _ => (y : G) ∈ L) ?_ L.one_mem (fun _ _ _ _ h1 h2 => L.mul_mem h1 h2) (fun _ _ h => L.inv_mem h) hy
      intro z hz
      apply Subgroup.subset_closure
      simp only [Finset.coe_union, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image]
      exact Or.inl ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact key _ hm
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro g _
  have hq : (g : G ⧸ N) ∈ Subgroup.closure (T : Set (G ⧸ N)) := by rw [hT]; trivial
  have key : ∀ q ∈ Subgroup.closure (T : Set (G ⧸ N)), ∃ l ∈ L, (l : G ⧸ N) = q := by
    intro q hq
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction (p := fun y _ => ∃ l ∈ L, (l : G ⧸ N) = y) ?_ ⟨1, L.one_mem, rfl⟩ ?_ ?_ hq
    · intro y hy
      refine ⟨Quotient.out y, Subgroup.subset_closure ?_, QuotientGroup.out_eq' y⟩
      simp only [Finset.coe_union, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image]
      exact Or.inr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ _ _ _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a * b, L.mul_mem ha hb, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a⁻¹, L.inv_mem ha, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hlg⟩ := key _ hq
  have h3 : l⁻¹ * g ∈ N := (QuotientGroup.eq).1 hlg
  have h4 : g = l * (l⁻¹ * g) := by group
  rw [h4]
  exact L.mul_mem hl (hNL h3)
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal], Group.FG N → Group.FG (G ⧸ N) → Group.FG G
